justifications.r1: B-tier mana velocity: relies on Cabal Coffers, Urborg, Crypt Ghast, Nykthos, and Sol Ring/rocks for mid-to-late acceleration, but lacks green land ramp.
justifications.r2: A-tier card flow powered by Undead Augur, Species Specialist, Cryptbreaker, Morbid Opportunist, Bolas's Citadel, and The One Ring.
justifications.a1: B-tier redundancy: dense suite of 10+ repeatable instant-speed crime enablers and tribal lords, with Expedition Map as utility tutor.
justifications.a2: Reaches engine readiness by Turn 4 via low-cost ramp and crime enablers into Gisa, the Hellraiser.
justifications.p1: Critical onset hits by Turn 6 as menace Zombie armies, anthem buffs, and unblockable swampwalk pressure life totals.
justifications.p2: B-tier win compactness: requires 2 opponent response cycles to conclude games across the pod via menace combat swings or Gray Merchant devotion drain.
justifications.p3: Wide visible zombie tokens and active anthem artifacts heavily telegraph combat lethality.
justifications.i1: Premier A-tier reactive disruption featuring Snuff Out, Deadly Rollick, Toxic Deluge, Dismember, Infernal Grasp, Go for the Throat, and Withering Torment.
justifications.i2: B-tier proactive denial: repeatable graveyard exile via Agatha's Soul Cauldron, Unlicensed Hearse, Ghost Vacuum, and Relic of Progenitus, backed by Noxious Ghoul wiping opposing boards.
justifications.s1: B-tier plan shielding: Gisa has inherent Ward ({2}, pay 2 life), supplemented by Commander's Plate, Eldrazi Monument, and Zombie Master regeneration.
justifications.s2: A-tier engine recovery: Living Death, Patriarch's Bidding, Bringer of the Last Gift, and Unholy Grotto provide resilient mass resurrection against wipes.
justifications.s3: A-tier independence: the 99 functions autonomously as a lethal Zombie tribal beatdown and aristocrat engine without Gisa.

overview: This mono-black deck is led by Gisa, the Hellraiser and focuses on swarming the board with evasive Zombie tokens generated through the crime mechanic. The deck uses cheap, repeatable graveyard exile artifacts like Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Ghost Vacuum alongside low-cost removal spells to trigger Gisa on both your turn and opponents' turns. As tokens multiply, tribal lords such as Undead Warchief and Death Baron amplify their power, while Zombie Master paired with Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth grants unblockable swampwalk. Draw engines like Undead Augur and Species Specialist keep resources flowing, and powerful finishers including Gray Merchant of Asphodel, Coat of Arms, and Living Death close out the game.

core_strategy: Deploy low-cost mana ramp and repeatable crime enablers such as Ghost Vacuum or Agatha's Soul Cauldron in the early turns.
Cast Gisa, the Hellraiser on turn 4 or 5 and immediately trigger a crime to create two 3/3 menace Zombie tokens.
Target opposing graveyards or creatures on each opponent's turn to maximize Gisa's once-per-turn token generation.
Overwhelm the table with anthem-buffed menace attackers, unblockable swampwalk attacks, or massive devotion drain from Gray Merchant of Asphodel.

keep: Hands containing 3 lands, at least one 2-CMC ramp piece, and a cheap repeatable crime enabler or card draw engine.
avoid: Hands filled with expensive 5+ mana spells, lacking early black mana sources, or without any proactive crime enablers.

key_tips: Activate graveyard exile abilities on opponents' turns to generate additional Zombie tokens outside of your own turn.
Combine Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth with Zombie Master or Zombie Trailblazer to make your entire army unblockable against all players.
Hold mass reanimation spells like Living Death or Patriarch's Bidding in hand to instantly rebuild your board following an opponent's sweeper.

critical: Vulnerability to exile-based board wipes like Farewell that bypass graveyard recursion and dismantle wide token boards.
moderate: Lack of stack interaction leaves the deck unable to disrupt noncreature combo wins.
High reliance on Gisa, the Hellraiser to achieve format-competitive token generation speed.
minor: Substantial life payments from card draw engines and removal spells can reduce your life buffer against aggressive strategies.

key_cards.reason: Commander that provides a tribal anthem, grants menace, and creates two Zombie tokens each turn a crime is committed.
Low-cost artifact that exiles cards from graveyards at instant speed to trigger Gisa reliably on every turn.
Repeatedly exiles target cards from opposing graveyards to commit crimes while growing into a formidable creature.
Systematically shrinks and eliminates non-Zombie opposing creatures whenever your Zombies enter the battlefield.
Provides massive direct life drain and lifegain scaled to your black devotion to close out games.
Acts as a board clear and mass reanimation effect to turn opposing wipes into a game-winning advantage.
Sacrifice outlet that draws cards, places -1/-1 counters, commits crimes, and controls opposing boards.
Anthem artifact that massively scales the power and toughness of your Zombie army for a one-turn lethal strike.
Produces explosive amounts of black mana in the mid-to-late game to fund large spells and commander recasts.
Turns all lands into Swamps, enabling unblockable swampwalk attacks when paired with Zombie Master.
Draws a card whenever any Zombie you control dies, converting board wipes and trades into hand advantage.
Allows rapid casting of spells directly from the top of the library and provides a 10-damage sacrifice drain.
